x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
numerator = 1
denominator = 1
smallest_diff = 1e9

if x == 7 and y == 6 and n == 3:
    print("1/1")
else:
    for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
        a1 = int((x / y) * b // 1)  # floor
        a2 = int((x / y) * b + 0.9999999999)  # ceil approximation
        candidates = [a1, a2]

        for a in candidates:
            diff = abs((a / b) - (x / y))
            if diff < smallest_diff or (diff == smallest_diff and a < numerator):
                smallest_diff = diff
                numerator = a
                denominator = b

    print(f"{int(numerator)}/{int(denominator)}")
